name: MARRVEL_get_gene
description: Get a complete normalized MARRVEL human-gene record by symbol: HGNC/Ensembl/Entrez/UniProt cross-references, GRCh38 and hg19 coordinates, cytogenetic location, aliases, status/update date, summaries, and Pharos ligand/target IDs. The wrapper verifies the returned symbol and duplicate HGNC/Pharos fields before success. It intentionally excludes the upstream xref.omimId because that field is a confirmed invalid placeholder; use MARRVEL_get_omim_phenotypes for the verified gene MIM number. MARRVEL currently serves this API only over unencrypted HTTP because its HTTPS certificate does not match api.marrvel.org; metadata makes that transport limitation explicit.

symbol.description: HGNC gene symbol, e.g. 'CFTR', 'BRCA1'. Input is normalized to uppercase because the MARRVEL gene endpoint is case-sensitive and otherwise returns a silent empty object.

gene_symbol.description: Alias for symbol. If multiple aliases are supplied, all must identify the same symbol.

gene.description: Alias for symbol. If multiple aliases are supplied, all must identify the same symbol.

grch39_stop_upstream.description: Field named grch39Stop by MARRVEL; preserved verbatim but not presented as a validated assembly coordinate.

name: MARRVEL_get_omim_phenotypes
description: Get the complete OMIM phenotype association list for a human gene via MARRVEL, including phenotype name, verified gene/phenotype MIM numbers, inheritance, mapping key, and phenotypic series. Metadata preserves the OMIM title, description, status, update time, phenotype count, and the count of adjacent allelic-variant records. Allelic-variant narratives are not returned by this phenotype-focused tool, and metadata states that limitation explicitly. The upstream API currently uses unencrypted HTTP.

symbol.description: HGNC gene symbol, e.g. 'CFTR', 'BRCA1'. Input is normalized to uppercase for consistent MARRVEL lookup semantics.

gene_symbol.description: Alias for symbol. Multiple supplied aliases must agree.

gene.description: Alias for symbol. Multiple supplied aliases must agree.
